assets.savedKey: Saved. Leave blank to keep the key.

assets.secretsHint: The API key is encrypted on save and is never returned to this page.
assets.inUse: Remove or change these environment references before removing the connection.
assets.runtimeHint: Templates must include Python 3 at /usr/bin/python3. The current execution lease is temporary (at most one hour). Changing configuration or rotating a key can stop affected execution; reselect and save the updated environment in assistant settings. History and memory are retained.
assets.deleteEnvironment: Only the saved environment configuration is removed, not its E2B template, history or memory. Active execution may be interrupted.
assets.deleteConnection: Only the saved connection and its local credential are removed. This does not revoke the key at the provider.
assets.identity: Sign in to manage your assets.
assets.failed: The request could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Read the latest list before deciding what to do; mutations are not retried automatically.
assets.conflict: Configuration changed, or the previous save may already have succeeded. Review the refreshed list and reopen the editor; the original draft has not been reapplied.
assets.invalid: Semak medan wajib dan tetapan lanjutan.
assets.credential_in_use: This connection is referenced by an environment. Remove or change that reference first.
assets.credential_missing: The selected connection is no longer available. Choose another connection.
assets.custom_endpoint_admin: Only instance administrators can configure custom E2B service addresses.
assets.audience_changed: Create another connection to use different service addresses. Saved keys cannot be redirected.
assets.limit: The configuration limit has been reached.
assets.missing: This configuration no longer exists. Refresh the list.
assets.draftRetained: An unsaved draft is kept on this page.
assets.discardAbout: Your unsaved input will be cleared. Nothing will be saved or sent to the provider.
assets.updatedEnvironment: Connection saved. Your environment draft is restored; save it when ready.

Menukar templat atau kunci boleh mengganggu pelaksanaan aktif; pembantu terjejas perlu memilih semula persekitaran. Nama dan tetapan dikongsi, tetapi kunci tersimpan tidak ditunjukkan kepada ahli.
